mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.phonenumber IS NULL OR TRIM(u.phonenumber) = '' THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phonenumber) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(u.phonenumber, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phonenumber, 4)) ELSE '***' END

n.id AS notification_id, n.request_id, n.type, n.title, n.body AS content, n.business_type,
COALESCE(n.business_id, n.biz_ref) AS business_id, n.create_by AS created_by, n.create_time AS created_at
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_notification_receiver r WHERE r.notification_id = n.id AND r.deleted_flag = 0) AS receiver_count FROM user_notification n WHERE n.id = #{notificationId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.user_id, u.nick_name AS nickname, AS phone_masked, r.read_at FROM user_notification_receiver r JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.notification_id = #{notificationId} AND r.deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY r.id
SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_notification_receiver r WHERE r.notification_id = n.id AND r.deleted_flag = 0) AS receiver_count FROM user_notification n WHERE n.request_id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1

SELECT CONCAT_WS('|', IFNULL(n.type, ''), IFNULL(n.title, ''), IFNULL(n.body, ''), IFNULL(n.business_type, ''), IFNULL(COALESCE(n.business_id, n.biz_ref), ''), IFNULL((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.user_id ORDER BY r.user_id) FROM user_notification_receiver r WHERE r.notification_id = n.id AND r.deleted_flag = 0), '') ) FROM user_notification n WHERE n.request_id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1
